name: snipzr
description: Create branded short links, UTM campaign links and QR codes, and read cookie-less click analytics in Snipzr (snipzr.com), the URL shortener, from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Snipzr (snipzr.com) is a URL shortener for marketers and developers. Connect it to manage your short links from ChatGPT in plain language.

What you can do:
• Create short links one at a time, or up to 100 in one call, on the default domain or on your own branded domain, with custom back-halves.
• Build UTM campaign links that follow your workspace's UTM conventions, then shorten them.
• Find, update and delete links. Updates and deletes are marked destructive, so ChatGPT asks you first.
• Read clicks and QR scans per day for any link, with bot traffic counted separately, and campaign reports rolled up by utm_campaign.
• Make scannable QR codes in PNG, JPEG or SVG with your colors, a caption and a center logo.
• Check how many new links your account has left this period, and which workspaces and domains this connection can use.

You stay in control: when you connect, you sign in to Snipzr and choose the workspace ChatGPT may act in and what it may do, for example read-only. You can disconnect at any time in Snipzr Settings.

Requirements: a Snipzr account.

Privacy: the plugin calls only Snipzr's own API and receives only what each request needs, such as the address you ask to shorten.
capabilities: Create short links on your own domain
Read click and QR scan analytics
Update and delete links, with confirmation
